curve_definition: 95% detection probability at the injected grid frequency, circular orbit, phase extrema, fixed supplied noise and linear timing model
rule: Pulsar counted over the fraction of a period bin where margin times its 95% worst-phase curve is at or below the mass; hosting fraction f excluded when prod(1 - 0.95 f c_i) < 0.05
limits: Minimum mass (m sin i) for a 1.4 solar-mass pulsar (atlas) or the stated total inner mass (extra files); true masses are larger
Circular orbits on the searched grids only
Margin 1 assumes each supplied noise model is correct
Pulsars were selected as isolated and by data quality, not at random
Datasets with a fixed-noise crossing are left out, not counted as detections or as clean

extra.curve_definition: 95% detection probability on the search grid, circular outer orbit, worst phase, fixed published noise, inner orbit and Shapiro freedom projected; minimum mass for the stated total inner mass
